items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

ctx.x: It was the following weekend, they played some clubs and we come down to play for -- they had some -- some young disc jockey around here had a -- trying out for a TV show. He had the Jimmy Smith organ trio, Don Schwartz and Donald Bailey on drums -- the original Jimmy Smith.
He wasn't with them. It was Thornel. Farnell.
